fields.label: HF Repo
fields.description: → vllm serve <repo>; the name is the --served-model-name.

fields.label: vLLM Launch Profile
fields.description: The args required to serve this model (mapped to deploy/vllm role vars). Blank = flag omitted / role default.

fields.label: Max Model Len
fields.description: → --max-model-len. Cap for the KV cache; ≤ the model's native context.

fields.label: Modality
fields.description: multimodal → adds --language-model-only (serve the text LLM only).

fields.label: Is Embedding Model
fields.description: Pooling/embedding model — served at /v1/embeddings, not chat. → --task embed; the chat-only tool/reasoning flags are skipped.

fields.label: Gated
fields.description: Needs an HF token to download (passed as HF_TOKEN).

fields.label: Reasoning Model
fields.description: If set, the reasoning parser below is applied.

fields.label: Reasoning Parser
fields.description: → --reasoning-parser (only when Reasoning Model is checked). e.g. qwen3.

fields.label: Aliases
fields.description: Extra --served-model-name values (comma/space separated); old client model-names keep working.

fields.label: Extra Serve Args
fields.description: Freeform extra `vllm serve` flags appended verbatim, e.g. --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --max-num-seqs 64.
